items.name: Alert emails
items.what: Buttondown sends the alerts and the weekly roundup (Basic plan).

items.name: News check
items.what: An AI model (Claude) reads gaming news twice a day and suggests changes. I approve every one. Estimated from the real run logs.

items.name: Posts on X
items.what: X charged me $0.20 for a post with a link in it and about 2 cents for one without (I checked my own usage page in October 2026). So my posts there have no link and spell out the site's name instead. I also read one deals account's restock posts through X's paid API, to catch restocks fast. That's billed per post read (about half a cent each, as far as I can tell), and the site stops at 600 posts a month.
items.price: About 2 cents a post, plus up to about $3 a month for reading
